notes: This map is the machine-readable contract for fingerprint/IP privacy governance.
Retention is enforced by Mongo TTL indexes, scheduled cleanup jobs, or documented manual admin actions.
User account deletion currently removes the user_datas document; linked fingerprint/IP telemetry cleanup is tracked as a long-term debt item.

proxycheck-* datasets were added 2026-09-25 with the proxycheck.io IP-risk integration. The risk cache is TTL-bounded; the lookup-log and probe-report collections are read-only superadmin surfaces and still await a retention job (declared as an acknowledged gap). The lookup log additionally stores the decision handed to the caller.

policy_consents gained documentHash (which text revision was accepted) plus revokedAt/revokedIP/revokedReason (withdrawal audit trail) on 2026-09-30, and an owner-initiated hard delete via POST /api/policy/revoke {purge:true}. A superadmin CSV export (/api/admin/policy-consents/export) is the only bulk surface; it is audited and row-capped.

2026-10-03: audit_logs TTL narrowed 90d -> 60d (AUDIT_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS in src/models/auditLogModel.ts). Existing deployments must run `ts-node src/scripts/applyAuditLogTtl.ts` to change the live index in place — editing the schema alone does not update an existing TTL index.

2026-10-03: every dataset now carries a userFacing block (Chinese label / category / what / why / retention + the policy section that explains it). The privacy policy page renders that block through src/generated/privacyDataMap.ts, so the page cannot drift from this contract; `pnpm run check:privacy-data-map` enforces the generated file in CI.

Integration datasets added 2026-10-02: email_suppressions (bounce/complaint/unsubscribe suppression list, email address only, written by the Resend webhook, the public unsubscribe link, or a superadmin), recommendation_feedback (explicit like/dislike per user+style), and webhook_events (third-party webhook payloads; superadmin-only reads and a manual retention prune). All three are reachable from the integration health center (/admin/integrations).

2026-10-10: account_ip_signals added for the account risk aggregation (RC-06): it keeps the per-account login IP history together with the risk score observed at that moment, so an account keeps carrying the risk of the IPs it has used even after the IP-level cache (24h TTL) expires. Deliberately has no TTL so the evidence survives account deletion; retention is declared as an active-use window plus a legal-hold check instead.

2026-10-11: device_fingerprints added for the behavioural fingerprint matrix (RC-16): Canvas/WebGL/timezone/screen component hashes (no raw images) keyed by account + fingerprint id, used to detect component drift on one fingerprint and the same hardware being reused across accounts. Like account_ip_signals it has no TTL so the evidence survives account deletion; the source IP list is capped at the latest 20 entries.

2026-10-16: GeoGebra cloud projects, versions, comments and public-share snapshots are owner-scoped; deleting a project revokes its linked shares, and account soft deletion makes all owned shares inaccessible and removes their cover files.

2026-10-16: tickets and ticket_attachments added — the support ticket system previously stored user content (ticket text, contactEmail) and now also holds the new ticket fields (type inquiry/incident, related service + reference, related tickets, contact email) an attachment store (jpg/jpeg/png/gif/txt/pdf, 1MB per file, 5 per ticket, owner/superadmin downloads only) and attachment links (external URLs only — we never fetch them, and uploads for regular users are off by default behind the TICKET_ATTACHMENTS runtime switch).

2026-10-17: tickets gained optional CSAT feedback (csatRating 1-5, csatComment ≤500 chars, csatSubmittedAt) plus an auditable handling trail (events: status/priority/category/assignee/type/service/csat changes, capped at the latest 100, admin actor names redacted to 客服 for owners) and firstResponseAt / resolvedAt timestamps. The owner can submit or update their rating only after the ticket is resolved/closed; the comment is visible to the owner and superadmins only, while list summaries carry just csatRating.

datasets.purpose: Rotating long-lived client login tokens (sml_) for mobile clients: only the SHA-256 hash of the token is stored, plus the device binding and the rotation lineage that lets a leaked token family be revoked as a unit. `reusedAt`/`reusedIp` mark the superseded generation whose replay tripped the lineage revocation, for the admin lineage board

userFacing.label: 移动端长期登录令牌

retention.description: Mongo TTL index on ttlExpireAt drops the document once the generation expires; rotation only marks the previous generation superseded (it does not set revokedAt), and replaying that generation after the grace window revokes the whole lineage. Field-level retention is shorter for the routine IP fields: a generation that has been superseded for more than 30 days has lastUsedIp/rotatedIp unset by a periodic sweep, while reusedIp is kept as the incident record for the reuse board

delete.automatic: Mongo TTL on ttlExpireAt; admin user deletion and password reset call revokeAllAuthSessions(), which revokes these tokens by clientTokenHash
delete.gap: Superseded generations keep their lastUsedIp / rotatedIp rows until TTL expiry; there is no shorter security-hold job

export.reason: Security telemetry keyed by token hash; the token itself is not recoverable from the stored hash

datasets.purpose: Explicit like / dislike / not-interested signals per user and voice style, used to filter and rank TTS style recommendations.

userFacing.label: 推荐反馈
userFacing.what: 用户 ID、音色/风格 ID、喜欢或不喜欢（可附备注）、时间。
userFacing.why: 个性化推荐：记住你对音色与风格的偏好，用于排序与过滤。
userFacing.retention: 随账户保存，账户删除时一并删除。

retention.description: Kept while the account exists so the preference keeps applying; one row per (userId, styleId).

delete.current: rows carry userId and would need to be removed by an account-deletion cascade (tracked as a gap, same class as recommendation_history)
delete.manual: no admin surface today; a user can overwrite their own latest feedback through POST /api/recommendations/feedback

datasets.purpose: Inbound third-party webhook deliveries (Resend/Svix) for deliverability monitoring and incident forensics. `raw`/`data` are verbatim provider payloads and may contain recipient addresses.

userFacing.label: 第三方 Webhook 事件
userFacing.what: 事件 ID、来源、类型、状态、第三方原始 payload（可能包含收件人邮箱、邮件主题与正文片段）、时间与投递次数。
userFacing.why: 排查第三方回调（例如邮件投递与退信状态）与失败重放。
userFacing.retention: 无自动过期；超级管理员可执行清理（默认保留 90 天，先预览再删除）。

retention.description: No TTL; a superadmin prune keeps a configurable number of days (default 90) and runs as a dry-run first. Until an operator runs it, events are retained indefinitely.

delete.current: keyed by provider event id, not by Synapse account
delete.manual: POST /api/admin/integrations/webhooks/prune (superadmin + audit log; dryRun by default)

export.surface: GET /api/webhook-events (superadmin only; the list and detail endpoints are intentionally superadmin-gated because raw payloads carry third-party data)

datasets.purpose: Save a user's GeoGebra scripts and project metadata for cross-session editing and authorized team collaboration.

userFacing.label: GeoGebra 云端项目
userFacing.what: 项目标题、文件夹、标签、脚本内容、画布类型、收藏状态和所属工作空间。
userFacing.why: 让你在登录账号下保存、恢复和整理自己的数学工作台项目。
userFacing.retention: 项目保留至你主动删除或账号按平台规则处理；本地项目仅保存在当前浏览器。

retention.description: Cloud project records are owner-scoped and marked inaccessible when the account is soft-deleted; users can delete individual projects.

delete.accountDeletion: Subject deletion marker; access is denied immediately.

datasets.purpose: Provide user-requested project snapshots, comparison, and rollback.

userFacing.label: GeoGebra 项目版本
userFacing.what: 用户保存的项目脚本快照、版本说明、画布类型和保存时间。
userFacing.why: 支持查看历史、比较差异和恢复之前的项目内容。
userFacing.retention: 随项目保留；删除项目时一并删除版本。

retention.description: Version records are removed when the owning project is deleted and marked inaccessible on account deletion.

datasets.purpose: Allow authorized project collaborators to leave and resolve review comments.

userFacing.label: GeoGebra 项目评论
userFacing.what: 项目成员提交的评论、关联版本或图形对象、处理状态和时间。
userFacing.why: 支持团队成员围绕项目版本和图形对象进行审阅。
userFacing.retention: 随项目保留；删除项目时一并删除评论。

retention.description: Comments are removed with their project and marked inaccessible on author account deletion.

includes: comments authored by the current user

datasets.purpose: Publish a user-selected GeoGebra canvas snapshot and allow link-based viewing or forking.

userFacing.label: GeoGebra 公开分享
userFacing.what: 分享标题、脚本指令、画布类型、可选封面和 fork 设置。
userFacing.why: 让你通过分享链接展示画布，或允许他人复制后继续编辑。
userFacing.retention: 分享会持续有效，直到你撤销或删除；账号注销会立即关闭公开访问。

retention.description: Public snapshots remain available until revoked/deleted and are disabled on owner account deletion.

delete.accountDeletion: Set revokedAt and subjectDeletedAt; public reads return not found.

datasets.purpose: Serve an optional public preview image for an active GeoGebra share.

userFacing.label: GeoGebra 分享封面
userFacing.what: 你主动发布的画布预览图片。
userFacing.why: 让分享链接展示对应画布的预览。
userFacing.retention: 封面在分享撤销、删除或账号注销时不可再访问，并按清理规则移除。

retention.description: PNG files are stored outside MongoDB and removed when their share is deleted or revoked.

export.surface: Public cover URL while the share is active

datasets.purpose: Store purpose-scoped files a GeoGebra tool needs: a user-supplied reference image for one AI generation run, and server-built export bundles the user asked for.

userFacing.label: GeoGebra 参考图与导出打包文件
userFacing.what: 你上传的参考图，以及你主动生成的打包文件（脚本与项目信息）及其格式、大小与到期时间。
userFacing.why: 参考图只用于你发起的那一次 AI 生成；打包文件用于你稍后下载自己的项目归档。
userFacing.retention: 参考图在生成任务结束后立即删除，最长不超过 6 小时；打包文件保留至到期（默认 7 天）或你主动删除。

retention.description: Assets carry an explicit expiresAt: reference images 6h, export bundles 7d. A sweep job deletes both the metadata and the file; account deletion marks them inaccessible immediately.

delete.accountDeletion: subjectDeletedAt is set immediately and files are removed by the sweep job.

datasets.purpose: Track asynchronous GeoGebra AI and export jobs so the user can see status, retry safely, and download their own results.

userFacing.label: GeoGebra 处理任务
userFacing.what: 任务类型、状态与进度、你提交的描述与脚本快照（或导出的项目标识）、生成结果摘要，以及失败原因分类。
userFacing.why: 让你能查看 AI 生成与打包任务的进度、重复提交时不会重复执行，并在失败时知道下一步。
userFacing.retention: 任务记录到期后自动清除（AI 任务默认 24 小时，打包任务默认 72 小时）。

retention.description: Jobs carry an explicit expiresAt (AI 24h, export 72h) enforced by a TTL index; in-flight jobs are marked expired first so the UI never shows a stuck run. Reference images are referenced by assetId and never stored inside the job document.

delete.accountDeletion: subjectDeletedAt is set immediately; records expire afterwards.

includes: job status and bounded result summaries

datasets.purpose: 记住用户今天已经看过 Pixel 操作提示，避免每次进入重复弹出。

userFacing.label: Pixel 操作提示的确认日期
userFacing.what: 只记录一个日期字符串（今天是否已确认过提示）。
userFacing.why: 让你不必每次进入都重新看一遍提示。
userFacing.retention: 只保存在当前浏览器的本地存储里，你可以随时清除站点数据。

retention.description: A single date string in localStorage; never contains card keys, accounts, passwords or 2FA material.

datasets.purpose: Map a Synapse-distributed card key to the upstream card key so the server can verify quota and submit tasks without ever exposing either secret to the browser.

userFacing.label: Pixel 卡密映射（管理）
userFacing.what: 你分发的卡密的哈希与遮罩值、上游卡密的加密密文、备注、启用状态，以及创建/修改这次映射的管理员账号。
userFacing.why: 让你分发的卡密能在服务端换取上游额度，同时避免明文卡密在界面、日志或 API 里出现。
userFacing.retention: 保留到管理员主动删除该映射；删除后新建任务将无法匹配到它。

retention.description: Admin-managed mapping rows; no TTL. Upstream card keys are stored encrypted (AES-GCM with the platform master key) and only masked values are returned by the API.

datasets.purpose: Record which upstream task belongs to which Synapse user (and under which distributed card key) so that task access, idempotent submission and cancellation stay scoped to the owner.

userFacing.label: Pixel 任务归属
userFacing.what: 你提交过的任务标识、对应的卡密哈希、服务类型、账号个数、提交状态与幂等标识。
userFacing.why: 让你只能看到自己的任务，并保证重复提交不会重复执行或重复扣额。
userFacing.retention: 保留在你的账号下，账号注销时立即不可访问。**账号原文、密码、辅助邮箱与 2FA 秘钥从不写入这里**。

retention.description: Owner-scoped rows without a TTL; access is denied immediately once the account is soft-deleted (subjectDeletedAt). Account credentials are never persisted here.

delete.user: 账号注销时统一处理（任务归属本身不提供单条删除入口）
delete.accountDeletion: subjectDeletedAt is set immediately; the rows expire with the account lifecycle.

datasets.purpose: Minimal traceability for upstream calls: which mapping was used, what happened, and how long it took - so operators can diagnose failures without storing account credentials or upstream response bodies.

userFacing.label: Pixel 调用溯源（管理）
userFacing.what: 请求标识、使用的卡密遮罩值、请求路径与结果分类、账号个数、请求/响应字节数与耗时。
userFacing.why: 出现失败或额度异常时，运维需要能定位是哪一次调用出了问题。
userFacing.retention: 默认保留 30 天后自动清除（可由运维配置调整）。

retention.description: TTL index on createdAt, 30 days by default (PIXEL_USAGE_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS). The document deliberately stores no account email/password/recovery/2FA, no upstream response body and no full result link.

delete.accountDeletion: rows expire by TTL; they hold only masked keys and counters

datasets.purpose: Store which upstream service Pixel is allowed to call, plus the operator attribution of the last change, so outbound calls stay within an explicitly configured allowlist.

userFacing.label: Pixel 上游集成配置（运营）
userFacing.what: 上游服务地址、允许访问的主机名单、启用状态、请求超时，以及最近一次修改这项配置的管理员账号。
userFacing.why: 保证只把请求发给被明确配置的服务；记录修改人以便事后核对。这项配置里不包含你的账号内容。
userFacing.retention: 保留至管理员下一次修改或删除该配置。

retention.description: Single admin-managed row (key="default"). Holds no user data and no account credentials; upstream card keys live in pixel_cdk_mappings under a separate encryption scheme.

datasets.purpose: Preserve, under a documented legal process, the data Pixel already collected (task attribution and masked usage trace) so it is not destroyed by normal cleanup while the case is open.

userFacing.label: 法律程序保全（Pixel）
userFacing.what: 被保全的账号标识、案件编号与法律依据、经办人，以及当时已有的任务归属与脱敏调用记录的副本。
userFacing.why: 在收到具备法律依据的调取要求时，平台需要把当时已有的记录完整保留下来，避免被常规清理误删。
userFacing.retention: 保全期间不自动清理；法律程序结束后解除保全，再保留 30 天后自动删除。保全不会额外收集你的账号内容。

retention.description: purgeAfter stays null while the hold is active (TTL ignores null); releasing the hold sets purgeAfter = release time + 30 days, after which the snapshot is reaped automatically.

delete.user: 保全无法由用户直接解除（法律程序决定）；解除后 30 天自动删除
delete.accountDeletion: account deletion does NOT remove a held snapshot; it is skipped while the hold is active

datasets.purpose: Record the per-case approval that is the ONLY condition under which Pixel may retain account content, together with its legal basis, approver and expiry.

userFacing.label: 内容留存的个案审批（Pixel）
userFacing.what: 被审批的账号标识、案件编号与法律依据、审批人与审批时间、有效期及是否已撤销。这张单子本身不含任何账号内容。
userFacing.why: 只有在具备法律依据或你明确授权的情况下，平台才会把一次提交的账号内容留存下来；这张单子就是该限定条件的凭证。
userFacing.retention: 审批到期后再保留 180 天后自动删除。

retention.description: TTL 180 days after the approval expiry, kept only long enough to explain why content was retained.

delete.user: 审批单由超级管理员创建/撤销
delete.accountDeletion: approval records are compliance evidence and are not removed by account deletion; they expire by TTL

datasets.purpose: Retain one submission's account content when - and only when - an active per-case approval with a stated legal basis exists, so a lawful forensic request can be answered.

userFacing.label: 账号内容留存（仅限个案 · Pixel）
userFacing.what: 你在某一次提交里录入的账号行内容（加密保存）、对应案件编号与法律依据、留取时间与到期时间，以及被读取的次数与最后一次读取时间。
userFacing.why: 默认情况下账号内容不留存。只有在收到具备法律依据的要求（或你明确授权）时，平台才会为了配合该程序把这一次的账号内容留存下来。
userFacing.retention: 最长 30 天，到期自动删除；如果审批先到期，则跟随审批到期。

retention.description: Hard cap 30 days, always min(approval expiry, capture + 30d). Content is AES-256-GCM encrypted with a purpose-separated subkey; every read is audited with case ref, operator and evidence id.

delete.user: 到期自动删除（仅超级管理员可读取，且每次读取都进审计）

export.surface: 管理端 /api/admin/pixel/evidence/:id/read（仅超级管理员，逐次审计）

fields: synapse-geogebra-studio-v1: project metadata, scripts, local snapshots
datasets.purpose: Keep local GeoGebra drafts available in the same browser before cloud sync.

userFacing.label: 本地 GeoGebra 草稿
userFacing.what: 当前浏览器保存的项目标题、脚本、画布类型和本地版本。
userFacing.why: 允许你在不登录时继续使用本地工作台。
userFacing.retention: 仅保存在当前浏览器，直到你清理浏览器数据或删除本地项目。

retention.description: Stored in the current browser localStorage until cleared by the user or browser.

delete.manual: Delete project in the local project panel or clear browser site data

export.surface: Local project export/download in the GeoGebra page

datasets.purpose: Support ticket intake, AI-assisted troubleshooting, agent follow-up, and optional CSAT feedback with an auditable handling trail

userFacing.label: 客服工单与对话
userFacing.what: 工单标题与正文、你填写的联系邮箱、类型（咨询 / 故障）与相关服务、关联的其它工单、优先级与分类，以及工单里的全部对话（含智能助手的回复；AI 排查失败时仅客服可见的原因摘要）。工单解决后你可以提交 1–5 星满意度评价与可选文字评价（仅你与超级管理员可见），系统同时记录状态 / 优先级 / 分类 / 受理人变更的处理记录与首次响应、最近解决时间。处理记录在用户视角会把客服账号名脱敏为「客服」。
userFacing.why: 受理并跟踪你提交的问题与建议：客服与智能助手共用同一份上下文给出排查方案，管理端按状态 / 优先级 / 类型 / 相关服务排序与统计，并用处理记录完成交接；满意度评价用于衡量支持质量与回访低分工单。
userFacing.retention: 随账号保留：工单用于回查历史结论，不做定期清理；处理记录只保留最近 100 条变更；删除账号时按账号数据处理流程处置。

retention.description: Tickets are kept with the account as support history; there is no TTL on the collection

delete.target: kept as support history after account deletion (no cascade job today); a superadmin can remove a ticket on request

datasets.purpose: User-uploaded screenshots and documents attached to support tickets

userFacing.label: 工单附件（截图 / 文档）
userFacing.what: 你主动上传到工单的文件正文（仅 jpg / jpeg / png / gif / txt / pdf，单个不超过 1MB，单个工单最多 5 个）、原始文件名、大小、内容摘要与上传时间。下载权限限于工单属主与超级管理员。
userFacing.why: 让客服看到你描述的界面与报错原文，减少来回追问；附件是可选的，不上传不影响工单受理。
userFacing.retention: 与所属工单同生命周期；删除该附件后正文立即从服务器移除。

retention.description: Attachment bytes live as long as their ticket; deleting a single attachment removes the stored bytes immediately

delete.target: attachments follow their ticket (no cascade job today); the uploader, the ticket owner or a superadmin can delete one attachment through the ticket API

export.reason: Download is per-attachment through the ticket API (owner/superadmin only); there is no bulk export surface

datasets.purpose: Record an active legal hold that freezes physical deletion of the matched subject while an investigation is open.

userFacing.label: 法律保留记录
userFacing.what: 被保留对象的类型与标识、案件编号、保留理由、经办人、保留与解除时间。
userFacing.why: 收到具备法律依据的调取要求时，需要冻结相关记录的删除，并能说明谁在何时依据什么案件操作。
userFacing.retention: 保留至案件结束且由超级管理员按程序解除；解除后记录仍作为合规留痕保留。

retention.description: No TTL. Legal-hold metadata must outlive the ordinary 60-day audit window.

delete.accountDeletion: hold metadata is retained; the held subject data is not deleted while the hold is active

datasets.purpose: Keep an audit trail of legal-hold and forensic-export actions beyond the 60-day ordinary audit retention, because investigations commonly outlast it.

userFacing.label: 取证审计（不设期限）
userFacing.what: 谁在什么时候登记/解除法律保留、发起/批准/下载了哪个案件的取证导出，以及请求来源。
userFacing.why: 调查周期可能超过普通审计的 60 天；取证访问必须可追溯且不能被 TTL 静默清除。
userFacing.retention: 按内部合规策略长期保留，不设自动过期。

retention.description: No TTL by design (RC-35 / D16). Ordinary audit_logs remain 60 days.

delete.user: 无用户入口；仅按合规流程归档

datasets.purpose: Persist the two-person approval workflow and the SHA-256 of each delivered forensic archive.

userFacing.label: 取证导出记录
userFacing.what: 导出申请的发起人、批准人、案件编号、对象范围、时间窗，以及交付件行数与校验和。
userFacing.why: 取证交付需要双人确认并可证明交付件未被改动，因此申请与校验和必须长期可查。
userFacing.retention: 按内部合规策略长期保留，不设自动过期。

retention.description: No TTL by design (D10); the request and checksum are part of the evidence chain.
